what: SaaS tools have 50 features but users need only ~6, some missing or locked behind Enterprise; people prefer vibe-coding personal tools in 1 day instead of scouting alternatives and data lock-in.
why_us: Signals growing rejection of bloated multi-feature SaaS; opportunity for ultra-focused, personalizable AI-native tools or wrappers that avoid subscription fatigue.

what: OpenClaw wrappers hitting $6K-$33K MRR quickly; one from $0 to $27.9K MRR in 14 days via ads/SEO; trend like 2023 GPT wrappers but larger, with boilerplate tools emerging.
why_us: High-velocity AI micro-SaaS wave; proven monetization of specialized wrappers on new AI platforms.
engagement: 333 likes, 68 replies (Marc Lou post); related high engagement

what: LLM Gateway (open-source API gateway for LLMs) from zero to $470K all-time revenue / $8.4K MRR in 12 months, 714 paying customers, 34M+ requests.
why_us: Infrastructure layer for AI is monetizable even as open-source; verified via TrustMRR/Stripe.

what: Intercom $132/seat/mo + $0.99/AI response, Pipedrive up to $79/user; total $60-100k/yr for generic tools that don't know the business. Founder built custom CRM/support in 15 days, joining trend of replacing SaaS (Klarna example: $40M savings).
why_us: Clear willingness to pay for custom AI-powered tools that integrate domain knowledge; subscription fatigue + poor fit.
engagement: High implied interest from detailed post

what: Widespread complaints on AI tools (Sider, UseAI, Lisa AI etc.): misleading trials, hidden recurring charges, unclear limits, poor support, subscription fatigue. G2 notes pricing as top complaint (20% of reviews) even among satisfied users.
why_us: Opportunity for transparent, usage-based or one-time AI tools with clear pricing and better cancel flows.

what: Indie SaaS Reachlee crossed $1.8K MRR (from $1.2K-$1.5K updates); Evergreen AI surpassed 1K MRR. Steady public updates from solo founders.
why_us: Micro-SaaS still viable; MCP integrations and AI features driving growth.

what: TikTok API wrapper / app removing reposts reached $100k MRR in 10 months; niches still lucrative.
why_us: Simple API wrappers in specific platforms can scale to high revenue.

what: People note that vibe-coding allows replacing many SaaS (screenshot services, uptime, moderation etc.) previously paid for; levelsio and others report cutting costs by building custom.
why_us: Acceleration of 'software by you' trend; market for lightweight AI-assisted personal tools or marketplaces of them.
